released_owner_chunks.comment: Recovered protected body26. Histogram/log accumulator: count XOR 68E4E2871D9EAA9D, base XOR E6FD560FE0720685. F5 readable after flag-proven and EB-FF overlap analysis-only repairs. Denominator traced through wrapper39/body39 to decoded total count. Accumulate p*ln(p)/(-ln2), clamp 0..8, return trunc(value*1000). Recovered-state bin bound 256, not a proved global invariant. Bulk MBAs, remainder helper, input/caller and report consumer remain open. See KB/reversing-warden.md and warden-thread-query-recovery-20260930.json.
